_doc: Text fixes applied at import time, before the option shuffle. 'find' must occur exactly once in 'field' (default question_text).

stem_fixes.find: The third multiplies entry by entry, and the fourth adds the matrices.
stem_fixes.replace: Option C multiplies entry by entry, and Option D adds the matrices.
stem_fixes.why: Ordinal references to options must become letters so the option shuffle can remap them.

option_shuffle._doc: Rebalance answer positions per topic. Each series gets an equal share of A/B/C/D keys; option references in explanations are remapped. Items with options_fixed (source 'fixed': option order carries meaning) are never moved. after_duplicate_drop: duplicates are dropped before the shuffle so the shipped keys are balanced.
